## Important info

This will clash with any custom skin that modifies Eternal Aspect Diana chromas. You must own the skin and chromas and choose one of them in champ select. If you also want to have the form transformation tweak from my other mod check out the [releases tab](https://runeforge.dev/mods/a1dab040-bc41-499f-8b4d-421f726786a1/releases).

## Description

**Author**: Suriin

**Skin**: Eternal Aspect Diana chromas

**Affects**: VFX colors

Adds matching VFX to every chroma, base remains the same.
